suite: KumoSQL rules on SQLFluff refusal cases
score: 189/212 left alone or changed with a proof (189/198 KumoSQL can read), 0 wrong
metric: Each structure-rule (ST) and CV12 fixture from sqlfluff with no fix_str, a query sqlfluff leaves alone (correlated derived tables, recursive WITH, data-modifying CTEs, Jinja, CV12's outer joins), run through KumoSQL's own structural rules (lift_subqueries, the CTE rules, the predicate and parenthesis rules): every rule must either make no change or make a change it proves that keeps the meaning.
correctness: 0 wrong: every changed output is checked without the prover for a qualified column that lost its source, a data-modifying CTE that disappeared and a changed Jinja tag, and run with its input on 120 random DuckDB databases (optimizer-off rerun must agree). The baseline had 6 wrong: lift_subqueries moved 4 correlated derived tables (one correlated only in a later UNION ALL branch) and a Jinja subquery into top-level CTEs, and remove_unused_ctes dropped PostgreSQL data-modifying CTEs; all were fixed in the rules. 1 case is caught (an unproven garbled output from a PL/SQL block read in sqlglot's recovery mode).
held_out: 36/39 left alone or proved (36/37 readable), 0 wrong (the recorded 37/39 was stale, master measures 36/39); one case in five by hash of the case id. The baseline held-out score was 36/37 with 1 wrong (the PostgreSQL data-modifying CTE), which was read and fixed: tuned on test for that case
caveats: Proven counts 142 cases no rule changed plus 47 whose changes were all proved; unknown is 8 cases with a change KumoSQL's verification refused (correctly unproven, no difference found) and 1 caught. The recorded 190 was stale: origin/master measured 188 (142 + 46) before the independent lift check, which moves one case from refused to proved (a parenthesis removal around a bracketed join, `CV12/test_fail_join_with_bracketed_join`, because the prover no longer turns the bracketed join into a CTE). 14 are unsupported: dialects KumoSQL's BigQuery parser cannot read (Exasol, Spark VALUES aliases, PostgreSQL ~, T-SQL brackets) and 7 Jinja-templated queries, which the rules now leave exactly as written. Every case, held-out ones included, was visible while the fixes were made; the fixes are general (correlation and nested-WITH checks in the lifter, no rewriting of data-modifying CTEs or templated SQL). Neither lifted form the prover used to prove (a correlated derived table, a subquery reading a nested WITH name) is proven any more; both are regression tests in tests/test_sqlfluff_refusals_bench.py, not counted here, because no rule produces those outputs.
